entities.summary: Petrus Aureoli, often anglicized Peter Auriol, was a scholastic philosopher and theologian. Born in the late 13th century in Western Europe, he was a key figure in the development of scholastic thought during the Medieval period. Aureoli's magnum opus, the *Summulae contra Gentiles*, was a comprehensive response to the errors of the ancient Greeks and Romans, and it established him as a leading voice in the intellectual debates of his time. Through his works, Aureoli sought to reconcile faith and reason, laying the groundwork for the theological and philosophical traditions of the Western world. His influence can be seen in the thought of later figures such as Thomas Aquinas and Duns Scotus, and his ideas continue to be studied by scholars today.
